name: Stormbringer: Ascension and Power Surge modify Storm Ascendance natively (#1806, #3184)
contract: #1806 and #3184 report 'Spell Script / Aura Handler Not Implemented' for two passives that are plain Spell.dbc modifiers on Storm Ascendance (681110, SpellFamilyName 22). #1806: Ascension (301260) is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue[0]=1 SPELLMOD_DURATION, EffectBasePoints[0]=9999 + DieSides 1 = +10000 ms, class mask effect0/word2/bit0 intersecting 681110's own SpellFamilyFlags[2]=1; Storm Ascendance's own DurationIndex 8 -> SpellDuration.dbc row 8 = 15000 ms, so the modified duration is 25000 ms. #3184: Power Surge (800699) is aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue[0]=12 SPELLMOD_EFFECT2, EffectBasePoints[0]=9 + DieSides 1 = +10, same class mask, modifying effect index 1 of 681110 (aura 79 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, misc 126, EffectBasePoints[1]=19 + DieSides 1 = 20), so the modified amount is 30. Aura::CalcMaxDuration (SpellAuras.cpp:811-812), Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers (Unit.cpp:12149-12167) and SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod (SpellInfo.cpp:1472-1552, no family-22 special case) apply SPELLMOD_DURATION and SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 generically for every spell family, so no module code is needed for either passive. Values are the server's own Player::ApplySpellMod, measured before and after learning on the same actor, then confirmed on the live aura after casting 681110.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
BASELINE: Storm Ascendance's duration modifier is unmodified without Ascension
BASELINE: Storm Ascendance's magic-damage-done amount is unmodified without Power Surge
DISCRIMINATING (#1806): Ascension lengthens Storm Ascendance's duration by 10000 ms
Ascension leaves Storm Ascendance's damage-done amount untouched (class mask targets effect0/SPELLMOD_DURATION only)
Cast Storm Ascendance with Ascension learned
DISCRIMINATING (#1806) confirmation: the live aura's duration reflects the +10000 ms modifier
Let Storm Ascendance expire before isolating Power Surge
DISCRIMINATING (#3184): Power Surge adds 10 to Storm Ascendance's magic-damage-done amount
Power Surge leaves Storm Ascendance's duration modifier untouched (class mask targets effect0/SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 only)
Reset Storm Ascendance's 120000 ms recovery time before recasting (the 25500 ms wait only covers the modified 25000 ms aura duration, not the spell's own cooldown)
Cast Storm Ascendance with Power Surge learned
DISCRIMINATING (#3184) confirmation: the live aura's effect 1 amount reflects the +10 modifier
